findings.description: Unconditional early return for n == 0 bypasses weekend-to-Monday adjustment.
findings.evidence: Per SPEC.md: 'n == 0 returns start itself on a weekday and the following Monday on a weekend'. When called with add_business_days(date(2026, 11, 7), 0) (a Sunday), lines 5-6 return Sunday Nov 7 instead of the required Monday Nov 9. The early return must be conditional or removed so the weekend adjustment logic executes first.

review.summary: The function incorrectly handles the n == 0 case for weekend start dates by returning the input date directly, violating the specification which requires adjusting to the following Monday.
